about.title: About Lembas
about.sources: Lessons are based on the appendices on pronunciation, writing and languages, and on Elvish words and names that appear in the story. Each item records where it comes from. Explanations are written in our own words.
about.accuracy: Only vocabulary attested in the published works is used. Items still awaiting a check are kept out of the lessons. To dig deeper, the Eldamo lexicon is an excellent reference.
